correctness.rationale: The sixth moment of Thue-Morse dyadic polynomial T_h is the constant term of product |1-z^(2^i)|^6 and obeys the displayed exact 3x3 Laurent-coefficient recurrence; independent coefficient convolution of (T_h)^3 for h=0..7 equaled the matrix moments. Cubic root brackets put spectral radius <15, giving L6 prefixes O(N^(log2(15)/6)), Abel disk estimate, and Holder/Cauchy coefficient bounds O(n^beta) for j>=1 in (1-z)(A+-T)^6/64; main term binom(n+4,4)/64 dominates because beta=log2(15)<4. No effective final cutoff or fivefold theorem follows.
